name: Yamaoka Akira
source:
Another old friend of the protagonist, and the poster girl at the popular local cake shop, Orange Pekoe.

She's always been bosom buddies with the protagonist, and they can talk about seemingly anything. However, in recent days, she's been starting to get a strange sort of feeling that her attitude towards him is changing. All the same, she continues to spend her time every day with him as if it hasn't.

Likes: Her family's shop, the latest accessories
Dislikes: Mice (though she doesn't hate them so much as she's just scared of them)
Hobbies: Coming up with ideas for new types of donuts
